answer: Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. Nobody is waved through free: 300 stamped dockets, each costing $12 to have checked is the price, and the prism never covers it twice. A name gets on the books only through Boltbound market staple maker staple licence, because a licence market staple makers carry after forge trials. One quill, one entry. The tally keeps nectar.
